_comment: Per-world content for the Why not others, Limitations and Method pages. Moon = Artemis IV, Mars = SkyFall. No numbers are typed here: weights come from pipeline/config.json (via results/*.json → method.weights_pct), limits from missions.json, limitations from limitations.json → universal.<universal_key>.

moon.intro: Earth places that are not top analogs for the selected Artemis IV region (Moon south pole).

mars.intro: Earth places that are not top analogs for the selected SkyFall region (Mars northern mid-latitudes).

notes.text: The Artemis HLS landing-slope limit is not in our documents (status TODO), so it is not used as a filter.
Hard filters (elevation, slope, rock cover, thermal inertia) come from the SkyFall Mission Information Package. The TBD flags show which limits NASA still marks TBD.
